name: portable-device-readiness-workload
purpose: Exercise language, speech, vision, specialist and memory-edge movement without making model-quality claims.

coded_artifact.sha256_policy: per-run only: the archive records measured codec metadata and therefore its container hash is machine/run dependent
coded_artifact.unavailable_policy: record SKIP with the backend reason; do not substitute a different artifact

auxiliary_artifacts.purpose: Keep link and low-compressibility behavior separate from the named tensor contract.

consumer_outputs.interpretation: A matching hash proves byte preservation for this fixture and consumer; it says nothing about speech, vision or language quality.

route_contract.plain: transport the original bytes through the bounded two-stage path
route_contract.coded: transport coded ranges, decode and place into a plaintext buffer
route_contract.http_range: exercise range reads when the source advertises and honors them
route_contract.http_no_range: exercise the existing fallback when the source returns a full response
route_contract.sealed: exercise local authenticated private distribution only when the existing crypto backend is available

measurement_rules.cache: Use cache=off for loader arms; report whether a host cold read was actually controllable.
measurement_rules.resource_scope: Bounded current-process RSS/PSS/HWM sampling; child pages, allocator-specific, device and energy counters remain explicit UNMEASURED when unavailable.
measurement_rules.time_events: All readiness events use one time.monotonic_ns origin. Missing consumer events are null, not zero.
measurement_rules.parallelism: The campaign compares one and two fetch workers under one shared aggregate cap; extra threads must not be read as extra link capacity.
measurement_rules.failure: Induced failures remain in results.jsonl and errors/; detection rows carry the engineering verdict.
measurement_rules.strategic_evidence: Local fixtures establish mechanism behavior. Real device, host, customer, cost and authenticated-store evidence is reported unavailable unless supplied.
